isitan-idk.name: IDK circle cutting machines — hydraulic and motorized circle shears
isitan-idk.summary: Circle cutting shears cut round blanks — and on the IDK-5, 3.5 and 2 also inside diameters (rings) — from sheet clamped at its centre and rotated between two circular blades. The IDK-5 is the production machine: hydraulic centre clamp, motorized cutting-diameter adjustment, discs up to 78.7″ in 3/16″ steel and an optional flanging attachment that turns the edge of the disc up to 3/8″ for tank heads. The IDK-3.5 adds a pneumatic clamp to a 47″ machine, the IDK-2 and IDK-1.8 are rigid cast-frame motorized cutters for 14 ga sheet with foot-pedal control.
features: IDK-5: welded steel frame, hydraulic centre clamp, motorized cutting-diameter adjustment, inside-diameter cutting, mobile control panel
IDK-3.5: pneumatic centre clamp (116 psi air supply), motorized diameter adjustment, inside-diameter cutting
IDK-2: rigid cast frame, blades in bearings, foot pedal, inside-diameter cutting
IDK-1.8: rigid cast frame, blades in bronze bushings, foot pedal
Special-steel (1.2379) blades; shafts on conical bearings for long blade life; gearbox motor with brake
optional: IDK-5: flanging attachment for edge flanging up to 3/8″; digital readout
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

sahinler-sdk.name: SDK 6 · SDK 8 circular sheet cutting and flanging machines
sahinler-sdk.summary: Tank-head machines that cut a circle from plate and flange its edge on the same head: dished and flat heads from Ø21.7″ up to Ø12.5 ft (SDK 6) or Ø15 ft (SDK 8) in mild steel to 1/4″ – 5/16″ and stainless to 8 ga – 3/16″. The flanging rolls are driven through planetary gearboxes by electric motor (SDK 6) or hydromotor (SDK 8), the part carrier has two speeds and hydraulic up/down adjustment, hydraulic lateral supports hold the plate and an LCD touchscreen runs the cycle. One set of R1″ flanging rolls and one set of cutting blades are included; a Japanese-hat (top-hat) attachment, small-diameter attachment and stainless blade set are optional.
features: Cut and flange dished and flat heads up to Ø15 ft on the same head
Bottom and top flanging rolls driven by hydromotor (SDK 8) or electric motor (SDK 6) through planetary gearbox
Two-speed part carrier, hydraulic up/down; hydraulic-cylinder lateral supports
One set of flanging rolls (R1″) and one set of cutting blades included
optional: Blade set for cutting stainless steel
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

sahinler-efm.name: EFM 6 elliptical cutting and flanging machine
sahinler-efm.summary: For round and elliptical tank heads: the flanging head tilts 90° to both sides and follows a moving, changeable bottom template, so flat, crowned and elliptical bottoms are cut and flanged on the same head. Plate from 11 ga to 1/4″ mild steel (14 ga to 8 ga stainless) up to Ø118″; one set of R3/8″ flanging rolls, one set of cutting blades and one copy template are included, with a vacuum system optional for holding thin heads.
features: Flanging head tilts 90° to both sides for elliptical flanging
Moving, changeable bottom template for flat and elliptical sheets; copy template (1 pc.)
Round and elliptical flanging and cutting on the same head; flanges flat, crowned and elliptical bottoms
Planetary gearbox and gear system drive
One set of flanging rolls (R3/8″) and one set of cutting blades included
optional: Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor
